about_the_game:
Aetherglen is a story-driven farm-sim with in-depth crafting, exploration, and action-packed combat. While on a walk, you find yourself in an overgrown field unlike any you've seen before. An old man, Aldirith, introduces you to the world of fae and reveals that you are a Verdaal Si—someone who can harness the power of aether. With no way back to your previous life, you must restore Aetherglen to its former glory.

Core Gameplay:

Tend to your crops and animals, gather materials to craft better tools, armor, and buildings, and forge relationships with the townsfolk. Venture deeper into the land to uncover the secrets of the four Elemental Shrines, battling against the forces of blight that threaten Aetherglen.

Features:

  •  Shape Your World – Customize your home with multiple designs and freely place structures throughout the town. Nearly every building, from farms to shops, is yours to rebuild.

  •  Fight Back Against the Blight – Battle corrupted creatures and restore the land through farming and exploration. Each shrine holds a piece of the mystery behind the blight’s origins.

  •  Forge Relationships – Meet a diverse cast of characters, build friendships, and even find love. As Aetherglen prospers, more inhabitants will return to aid your journey.

  •  Dynamic Town Growth – Citizens won’t return on their own—ship valuable goods, restore critical landmarks, and prove Aetherglen can thrive once more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+, 64-bit OS
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics or NVIDIA GTX 660 minimum
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Aetherglen gives you the freedom to build your home anywhere on your land. Rebuild the town, attract new NPCs, and shape a thriving world through farming, crafting, and combat! Inspired by Rune Factory, Harvest Moon, Stardew Valley, and My Time at Portia.
